summary.text: Lorna Carlisle is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Merrimack 5, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and ran for the same seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Carlisle first ran for Merrimack 5 in 2022, when she and Ken Wells advanced from the Democratic primary and incumbents Louise Andrus and Deborah Aylward won the general election.
In 2024 she and David Nesbitt advanced from the Democratic primary, and Andrus and Aylward again won the general election.
